question: In which year did Narendra Modi propose to celebrate a day for yoga as ‘International Day of Yoga’ while speaking at the United Nations General Assembly?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2014.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narendra Modi **proposed to celebrate a day for yoga as **'International Day of Yoga'** while speaking at the **United Nations General Assembly** on **September 27, 2014.**
 
• The proposal was accepted by the **United Nations,** and the first International Day of Yoga was celebrated on **June 21, 2015.**
 
• Narendra Modi is the** current Prime Minister **of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Yoga **is a form of **physical, mental, and respiratory **integration.
 
• It enhances general health through** physical postures, breathing techniques, and meditation.**
 
• Thousands of years ago, yoga was created as a **spiritual exercise. **
 
• The ancient Hindu text known as the **Rigveda** is where yoga-like activities were first discussed.
 
• There are several references to yoga throughout the** Upanishads. **
